snippet.title: Onward! Autobattles - Trailer
snippet.description:
Onward! Autobattles by Dream Parable Studio

Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onwards! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.
